description: Connect this assistant to the user’s ShieldFive vault. Opens ShieldFive in the user’s browser, where they choose which folders the assistant may use and what it may do, then click Authorize; nothing is copied by hand. Call it when a vault_* tool says the vault is not connected or the connection expired. If it reports the user has not finished yet, wait for them and call it again.

reconnect.description: Replace a working connection with a new one. Only when the user asks.

name: vault_connect
title: Connect to ShieldFive
